notes.title: Help. I don't know what I'm doing ...
notes.notes:
Well, I feel quite embarrassed, but I somehow managed to upload a wrong (unfinished) version of 'Finding Fifi'. And it then took me way too long to notice, and fix. =( 

I confess : the Steam back-end is a complete mystery to me. I still get lost in its many screens, clicking random buttons until one seems to do what I was trying to accomplish. It seems I have absolutely no talent for it.

So, fingers crossed ... and I hope all is well now.
